title: 第513章 降服大圣
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

不过想到云峰的命令，浑天大圣还是将头箍套在了自己的脑袋上，因为他不这么做云峰就不出来，不这么做云峰就躲藏在他肚子里折腾。

此刻的浑天大圣是非常的懊悔，早知道就不假装变房子把云峰吞到肚子里去了，真是搬起石头砸自己的脚，他心里懊悔死了。

“好了，我已经把铁箍套在脑袋上了，你出来吧！”

将铁箍套在头上后，浑天大圣慌忙说道，然后张开了嘴巴。

云峰也不再废话，直接身子化为了一道流光飞了出来，飞出了浑天大圣的嘴巴，然后落在了大圣的面前。

“小师弟，你终于出来了？”

一边的二师姐马蓉，看到云峰出来后则大喜，连忙冲过来用手抱住了云峰。

鼻子里闻到云峰身上熟悉的男子汉味道，她心里开心死了，刚才她真的害怕小师弟就这么挂了。

但是现在好了，一切都安全了，彻底安全了。

“二师姐，我哪里是那么容易挂掉的，你太小看我了。”

云峰笑嘻嘻的安慰了一下二师姐，目光则看着浑天大圣，发现铁箍已经套在它的头上后则笑了起来，笑的很开心。

这个铁箍是云峰的法器之一，是以前云峰的师傅赐予他的。

这铁箍有变大变小的功效，如果有人将铁箍套在了脑袋上，云峰只要念叨咒语，铁箍就会缩小收紧，可以惩罚敌人。

可惜浑天大圣不知道这一点，他看到云峰出来后则彻底松了一口气，一双猴眼里也露出了凶光。

“你这个臭小子刚才在俺肚子里搞事情，害的俺痛死了，现在你终于出来了，给我死。”

他手一动直接从耳朵里取出来了金箍棒，金箍棒很快变大变长成为了一根黝黑无比的铁棍，他手持金箍棒朝着云峰狠狠的砸了过来。

云峰连忙拉着二师姐闪烁到了一边，金箍棒则砸到了两人原来的位置。

一声巨响，地面都被砸的裂开了，出现了数米的裂缝，可见威力。

“怎么了，大圣，你刚才不是说要做我奴隶吗，认我做主人吗？我刚出来，你怎么以下犯上殴打主人了？”

云峰则笑嘻嘻的说道。

“去你娘的，谁做你的奴隶？俺刚才是骗你的呢，不然你怎么会出来。给我死。”

浑天大圣大怒，抡起铁棒再次朝着云峰狠狠的砸了过来，就在此刻云峰忽然停止了笑容，张口念叨起了咒语。

“啊！”

在云峰念叨咒语的同时，浑天大圣脑袋上的铁箍顿时缩紧了，铁箍深深的嵌入了脑骨里。

浑天大圣疼的不行，铁棒直接掉在了地上，在地上打滚起来。

他现在的感觉就是脑门被数万只蚂蚁在咬一样疼的不行，他使劲的用手掰脑袋上的铁箍，可惜没用，不管使用多大的力气都掰不动。

“天啊，好神奇？”

一边的二师姐马蓉，看到这一幕后惊呆了，似乎明白了什么。

那套在浑天大圣脑袋上的铁箍是法器，可以变紧变小，云峰诱骗浑天大圣将这东西套在脑袋上，就是阴了他。

However, thinking of Yunfeng's order, the Great Sage Huntian still put the headband on his head, because if he didn't do this, Yunfeng wouldn't come out, and if he didn't, Yunfeng would hide in his belly and torment.

At this moment, the Great Sage Huntian was very remorseful. If he had known better, he would not have pretended to turn into a house and swallowed Yunfeng into his stomach. He really shot himself in the foot. He was filled with regret.

"Okay, I've put the iron hoop on my head. Come out!"

After putting the iron hoop on his head, Great Sage Huntian said hurriedly, and then opened his mouth.

Yunfeng stopped talking nonsense and turned into a stream of light and flew out, flew out of the mouth of the Great Sage Huntian, and then landed in front of the Great Sage.

"Junior brother, are you finally out?"

Ma Rong, the second senior sister on the side, was overjoyed when she saw Yunfeng coming out. She rushed over and hugged Yunfeng with her hands.

She smelled the familiar masculine scent of Yunfeng in her nose, and she felt so happy. Just now she was really afraid that her junior brother would die like this.

But now, everything is safe, completely safe.

"Second Senior Sister, how could I fail so easily? You underestimate me."

Yunfeng comforted the second senior sister with a smile, and looked at the Great Sage Huntian. When he found that the iron hoop had been put on its head, he laughed very happily.

This iron hoop is one of Yunfeng's magical weapons. It was given to him by Yunfeng's previous master.

This iron hoop has the effect of becoming larger and smaller. If someone puts the iron hoop on his head, Yunfeng only needs to recite a spell, and the iron hoop will shrink and tighten, which can punish the enemy.

It's a pity that the Great Sage Huntian didn't know this. When he saw Yunfeng coming out, he breathed a sigh of relief, and a pair of monkey eyes also showed a fierce light.

"You brat, you were doing something in my stomach just now, and it hurt me to death. Now you've finally come out, please die."

He took out the golden cudgel from his ear with a movement of his hand. The golden cudgel quickly grew in size and length and turned into an extremely dark iron rod. He held the golden cudgel and smashed it towards Yunfeng.

Yunfeng quickly pulled the second senior sister to the side, and the golden cudgel hit the two people's original positions.

There was a loud noise, and the ground was smashed open, with cracks of several meters appearing, showing its power.

"What's wrong, Great Sage? Didn't you just say that you wanted to be my slave and accept me as your master? I just came out, why did you beat the master?"

Yunfeng said with a smile.

"Fuck you, who will be your slave? I just lied to you, otherwise why would you come out. Die to me."

The Great Sage Huntian was furious, and he picked up the iron rod and hit Yunfeng hard again. At this moment, Yunfeng suddenly stopped smiling and opened his mouth to chant a spell.

"Ah!"

While Yunfeng was chanting the incantation, the iron hoop on the head of the Great Sage Huntian suddenly tightened, and the iron hoop was deeply embedded in his skull.

The Great Sage Huntian was in so much pain that the iron rod fell directly to the ground and rolled on the ground.

He now felt as if his forehead was being bitten by tens of thousands of ants and was in excruciating pain. He tried hard to break off the iron band on his head, but it was of no use. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't break it off.

"Oh my god, how amazing is that?"

The second senior sister Ma Rong on the side was shocked when she saw this scene and seemed to understand something.

The iron hoop that was put on the head of the Great Sage Huntian was a magic weapon that could be made tighter or smaller. Yunfeng tricked the Great Sage Huntian into putting this thing on his head, which was a trick on him.
